layers.label: Resident population
layers.description: Residents registered in the municipal padrón.

layers.label: Population density
layers.description: Registered residents per square kilometre of section area.

layers.label: Residents under 18
layers.description: Share of registered residents aged 0–17.

layers.label: Residents aged 65+
layers.description: Share of registered residents aged 65 and older.

layers.label: Five-year population change
layers.description: Change in registered residents from the same month of 2021 to the current month. Only reciprocal one-to-one boundary matches covering at least 95% of both sections are shown.

layers.label: Foreign-born residents
layers.description: Selected-country residents born abroad divided by all residents. Total means all residents born outside Spain.

layers.label: Foreign citizenship
layers.description: Selected-country residents with foreign citizenship divided by all residents. Total means all non-Spanish citizenships.

layers.label: 2021–2025 foreign-born-share change (4 years)
layers.description: Percentage-point change in the selected country's share of all residents. Only reciprocal one-to-one boundary matches covering at least 95% of both sections are shown.

layers.label: Activity rate
layers.description: Active population divided by the population aged 16 and over.

layers.label: Employment rate
layers.description: Employed population divided by the population aged 16 and over.

layers.label: Unemployment rate
layers.description: Unemployed population divided by the active population.

layers.label: Higher education attainment
layers.description: Residents with Educación superior divided by the population aged 15 and over.

layers.label: Low educational attainment
layers.description: Residents with Educación primaria e inferior divided by the population aged 15 and over.

layers.label: Earliest construction year
layers.description: Earliest recorded construction year; the full interval is shown in details.

layers.label: Estimated building height
layers.description: Estimated height above the footprint elevation; switch on 3D to extrude polygons.

notes: Population values are joined by official section identifiers; resident coverage must be at least 99.5%.
Longitudinal change is shown only for reciprocal one-to-one section matches covering at least 95% of both vintages; split and merged sections remain No data.

Country controls use 2025 INE sections for both birthplace and citizenship. Honduras and Paraguay are in Madrid's 2026 top ten but cannot be shown because INE groups them under Other countries of America.

The eight country-specific share maps use a common 0–10% scale and flag-derived sequential palettes; Total retains its own scale. Country-specific change retains the red-white-blue direction palette with a common ±5 percentage-point limit.
The foreign-born comparison is explicitly four years (2021–2025) and is expressed in percentage points.
Election shares use valid votes including blank ballots as the denominator.
Election totals exclude non-geographic votes when they are absent from polling-table data.
INE publishes no 2023 section values for the below-60% and above-200% median indicators in Carabanchel and Fuencarral-El Pardo; these remain No data.
Percentiles compare valid Madrid census-section observations; a higher percentile means a higher raw value, not necessarily a better outcome.
Transport is a static network snapshot; live vehicles and bicycle availability are intentionally excluded.
Building archives are split by district and checked against a 95 MB per-file publication limit.
